title: Reframing Object-Centric Reinforcement Learning: From Absolute to Relative Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.28197v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Object-centric reinforcement learning agents typically receive each object's position in a fixed global frame, even though their decisions usually depend on where objects are relative to one another. These absolute views often fail to capture the local context that is most relevant to the agent's behavior. As a result, an agent must relearn the same response at every location where a configuration can occur, and its performance collapses when the scene is merely shifted. In this work, we propose a shift toward Object-Relative Coordinates fixed to Anchor (ORCA), where entities are described in a relative frame of reference. To operationalize this idea, we introduce Object-Relative inductive-Bias Transformers (ORBiT), a transformer-based architecture for processing anchor-relative inputs in reinforcement learning. translated_title: 重新审视以对象为中心的强化学习：从绝对表示到相对表示
translated_abstract: 以对象为中心的强化学习智能体通常接收每个对象在固定全局坐标系中的位置，然而它们的决策往往取决于对象之间的相对位置。这种绝对视角常常无法捕捉到与智能体行为最相关的局部上下文。因此，智能体必须在每种配置可能出现的每个位置重新学习相同的响应，而当场景仅仅发生平移时，其性能就会大幅下降。在这项工作中，我们提出转向固定于锚点的对象相对坐标（ORCA），即在一个相对参考系中对实体进行描述。为了实现这一想法，我们引入了对象相对归纳偏置Transformer（ORBiT），这是一种基于Transformer的架构，用于在强化学习中处理锚点相对输入。我们的结果表明，这些相对表示能够提升MLP和Transformer智能体的性能。此外，我们……
tldr: 该论文提出将强化学习中的对象表示从绝对全局坐标重构为固定于锚点的相对坐标（ORCA），并设计了ORBiT架构来处理这种相对输入，从而提升MLP和Transformer智能体的性能及其对场景平移的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes reframing object-centric reinforcement learning from absolute global coordinates to anchor-relative representations (ORCA), and introduces ORBiT, a transformer-based architecture for processing anchor-relative inputs, which improves the performance and shift robustness of both MLP and transformer agents.
